हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: A young man discovers he can heal or kill with a single touch. Hiding his secret, he vanishes and builds a powerful empire under a mysterious identity. Years later, he returns to save a dying girl and the woman he once loved. But when a corrupt family resurfaces, he must face his past and choose if his power will save lives or destroy everything.
